question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a red ball, Bob has a blue ball, Claire has a gold ball, Dave has a teal ball, and Eve has a orange ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Claire and Eve swap balls. Then, Eve and Bob swap balls. Then, Eve and Claire swap balls. Then, Dave and Alice swap balls. Finally, Dave and Bob swap balls. At the end of the game, Bob has the
Options:
(A) red ball
(B) blue ball
(C) gold ball
(D) teal ball
(E) orange ball
solution:
Ball colors in order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve):
Initial: (red, blue, gold, teal, orange)
After Claire and Eve swap: (red, blue, orange, teal, gold)
After Eve and Bob swap: (red, gold, orange, teal, blue)
After Eve and Claire swap: (red, gold, blue, teal, orange)
After Dave and Alice swap: (teal, gold, blue, red, orange)
After Dave and Bob swap: (teal, red, blue, gold, orange)
Bob has the red ball, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
